title: coperceive pipeline registration
description: A user-registered model pipeline: a script, the interpreter that runs it, its server environment and a typed argument schema. coperceive validates values and passes them as argv elements only. The pipeline writes the open output contract in docs/spec/pipeline-output.md.

script.description: Path inside the profile's data roots; absolute paths and '..' are refused.

name.description: Credential-like names (token, password, secret, api_key, private_key) are refused: secrets come from the environment.

default.description: Typed default; omitted when the argument is required.
